The rule covers the logged area, the e-mails, the bell and WhatsApp messages too; `lib/i18n/copy-rules.test.ts`, pgTAP `0033_copy_rules` and the e2e text check fail when a mark comes back.
- **Colour on text**: under the provisional palette no hue reaches 4.5:1 as small text on a light ground, so hues go on icons, bars and fills while the words keep text colours. The shared components follow it; a page must too.
- Motion is CSS first: the hero entrance and `Float` are CSS animations, `Reveal` is a CSS transition started by `watchEntry` (one shared IntersectionObserver in `components/marketing/motion.ts`), `CountUp` is a short frame loop. GSAP is loaded by `Parallax` alone, on demand. Never add a scripted timeline or a ScrollTrigger to a page, and never an animation without an end. Transform + opacity only, honoring `prefers-reduced-motion`. Never import GSAP in admin code.
- Site identity (name, tagline, siteUrl, favicons) comes from `apps/web/src/brand.ts`; the logo is the single component `components/logo/logo.tsx`.
- **Measurement is declared, never a new tracker.** A click worth measuring carries `data-track="<event>"` and `data-track-<prop>` attributes (or `trackAttributes()` from `lib/site-events.ts` on a link built in code), a section worth measuring passes `track="<key>"` to `Section` or the component that wraps one, and the one listener in `MarketingAnalytics` reports them to GA4 and the Pixel. The vocabulary is the type in `lib/site-events.ts` (`section_view`, `cta_click`, `faq_open`, `contact_click`): add to it there before using a new name. Never add PostHog or any other tracker, never write site events to the database, and never run a tracker inside the logged area or on a page a passenger opens by token.

===== .claude/rules/web-boundaries.md =====

# apps/web boundaries

- `apps/web` is the only app in this repo. Code shared between the app, the jobs and tooling lives in `packages/*`.
- Do not redefine theme tokens locally (`--primary`, `--grey-*` etc.) — they come from `@flyee/design-tokens`.
- This repo IS the ONE product: the platform for law firms (accounts, firms, cases, documents, courts, messaging, billing of the ONE subscription). Domain rules that decide something (forum, deadlines, prescription, eligibility) live in a package as pure functions with tests, never inside a page or a route handler.
- A page or route never talks to a vendor directly: it goes through the package adapter (real, fake, contract test), and through an RPC that receives the firm when it writes.
- The flyee.club surfaces (CLI delivery and OAuth, the module catalog, the club screens and consoles) are being removed in M0: do not build on them or extend them.

===== CLAUDE.md: Where things stand =====

## Where things stand

- **Built:** M0 (verified on 2026-10-08), M1 (sprints S1 to S3), M2 (sprints S4 to S7, except the test of the filing station at Projudi), M3 (sprints S8 to S10, to its end on 2026-11-11), what M4 and M5 needed of nobody outside (the CRM, the check of every message, the evidence kit, the numbers by lawyer with their margins, ONE's usage events) and, of M6, the migration by the OAB, its x-ray and the module versioned as data (2026-11-11). What each part delivered, with its migrations, is in `docs/HISTORICO.md`, oldest first.
- **Waiting on the owner:** the checklist, with a state per item, is the Claude Doc "ONE · O que providenciar fora da plataforma" (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/2b7654a2-a43b-407e-b042-c27c43ea3664). The code waits on the REDEMET registration, the Supabase staging and production projects in São Paulo, the Vercel Pro plan, the official identity, the legal texts, the platform's app at Meta, the Serpro contract, FlightAware's key, the court aggregator (trial keys, a sample of lawsuits outside Goiás, then a contract), the header of an Astrea export, the test of the filing station in eproc and PJe with a lawyer, the goal a triage category must meet to leave the shadow, and the Google Cloud project for the Calendar API. The detail of each item is in the state of 2026-11-11 at the end of `docs/HISTORICO.md`.
- **Set aside:** the half-finished public-shell refactor of the previous product is `stash@{0}` ("pre-ONE: refatoração da casca pública sem MUI"). It is not part of ONE's plan.
- **Next:** of the plan (`docs/ONE-PLANO-DESENVOLVIMENTO.md`), what waits on the owner: the AI's tuning per firm (the AI included in a tier), the official site (the identity) and the checklist below. Still the owner's before the screens where a passenger registers a trip: FlightAware's key, the legal opinion on soliciting clients and the Meta app. Open from the owner's points of 2026-10-13: the MNI client (`entregarManifestacaoProcessual`, with a stand-in where the court stands) and the filing by ONE in the court's own channel, each court checked against its written rules first.
- **This section stays short:** `npm run harness:check` holds it under 3,000 characters. What a part delivered goes to the end of `docs/HISTORICO.md`, and a decision of the owner goes to "Product decisions the code assumes".
